transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm only here because my family—my sister, my mom, and even a couple of my so-called friends—insisted I come talk to someone, but honestly, it's them who need to be looked at. They keep waving these... these bank statements in my face, these pieces of paper that they say prove nothing is missing from my accounts. But I know what's going on. I've known for over a year now. It started small, you know? Just a few dollars here and there, things not adding up. But then I started noticing the patterns. They're hiding my money. And it's not just a simple theft, oh no. It's elaborate. They use all these things to cover their tracks—sudden bills they claim we have to pay, these local fundraisers they suddenly care so much about, and all these elaborate plans for trips they say we're going to take. It's all a smokescreen! Every time they talk about a vacation, I know it's just a way to funnel my money out without me noticing. And they think I'm stupid, they think I won't see right through it. But I do. I see it all. And I have to keep confronting them, I have to keep pushing, every single day if I have to, until someone finally breaks down and tells me the truth about where my money is going. They can't keep lying to me forever, they just can't.
Do you feel like these people are plotting against you specifically?

Specifically me? Yes! Exactly! Who else would they be doing this to? It’s all aimed right at me, I know it is. They all get together—my mom, my sister, those people I thought were my friends—they probably sit around whispering about it when I’m not in the room, planning their next move. And then they gang up on me. They literally gang up on me and shove those bank papers in my face again and again, pointing at the numbers, going on and on about how it proves nothing was taken. They act like I can’t do basic math or something, like I’m just gonna look at a piece of paper they probably printed off some fake website and go, "Oh, okay, I guess my money is fine." 

But I’m not dumb! It’s been over a year. A whole entire year of me knowing exactly what they are doing, knowing they are hiding my money from me. And they make it so personal, the way they cover it up. They sit there in my face and make up these sudden bills, like, "Oh, the pipes are leaking, we need this much," or they start talking about these local fundraisers... suddenly everybody is just so charitable and they care so much about the community center or whatever, just to explain where my cash went. And the trip plans! They will spend hours at the kitchen table talking about these big vacations we're supposed to go on, just mapping it all out so they have a convenient excuse for why my account is draining. 

It’s a whole plot, just to steal from me and make me look crazy when I catch them. And that’s exactly why I have to keep confronting them. I don't care if they get mad, I don't care if they cry, and I don't care if they drag me to doctors like you. I'm going to keep getting in their faces, every single morning, every single night, asking them where my money is. I have to keep pushing them and pushing them until one of them finally breaks down, slips up, and tells me the actual truth about what they've done with it. Because they are doing this to me, and I won't let them get away with it.
Have you ever had a time, even for a brief moment, where you doubted that your family and friends were stealing from you?

Doubt it? Doubt it?! Why... why on earth would I doubt it? No, absolutely not, not even for a single second. Look, I know what you’re trying to do, you’re trying to see if I’m unsure, if maybe I’m just confused or something. But I am not confused. I came in here today because my family and friends keep saying—keep insisting, shoving it in my face—that these bank papers prove nothing was taken. They just keep pointing at the numbers, like, "Look, look, it's all there!" But it’s not all there. It's not! 

For over a year, over a whole entire year, 365 days of this nightmare, I have known exactly what they are doing. I’ve known they’re hiding my money. And they think they are so clever about it, too. They think I don't see how they use all these sudden, unexpected bills—like, who suddenly has to pay that much for a plumbing issue that I didn't even see a plumber come fix? And the fundraisers! Oh, suddenly my sister is the most charitable person in the world, donating to every little cause, every bake sale, every community center project. And the trip plans! They sit there with brochures and laptops, talking about these grand vacations to cover up where the money is really going. 

It's all a distraction. It's a smokescreen. And they think if they just keep showing me those fake bank papers, I'll just give up. But I won't. I absolutely will not. I have to keep confronting them. I have to. Every time they bring up a fake bill, every time they mention a trip we're never going to take, I am going to be right there, in their faces, demanding answers. I will keep pushing and pushing and pushing until one of them finally cracks and tells me the truth. Because I know I am right. I know it. There is no doubt. None at all. They are stealing from me, and I am not going to stop until I get my money back and they admit what they've done.
Do you think these people are trying to harm you in any way beyond just stealing your money?

Harm me? Like, physically? Or like, out to ruin my life in other ways? You mean like poisoning my food or trying to get me locked up or something? No, no, I don't... I don't think they're doing that. I mean, they dragged me in here, sure, but I think that's just part of the money thing. It all comes back to the money. It always comes back to the money with them. 

See, if they wanted to hurt me physically, they could have done that a long time ago. My sister has a key to my apartment, for crying out loud. She could come in while I'm sleeping if she really wanted to do something like that. But she doesn't. Because this isn't about hurting me like that. It's about the cash. It's about the fact that for over a year, they have been siphoning off my funds, and they think they are so slick with their little cover-ups. 

Like I said, the bills, the fundraisers, the trips... it's all financial. Every single move they make is calculated to drain my accounts while making it look like normal, everyday expenses. And they shove those bank statements at me—those stupid, printed-out pieces of paper that they probably doctored up on a computer—saying, "Look, everything is fine, you're just stressed, let's talk to a doctor." But the doctor thing, bringing me to you, that's just their latest tactic to discredit me so they can keep stealing! If they can convince you I'm crazy, then who is going to believe me when I say my money is gone? No one! 

So no, I don't think they're trying to, like, physically attack me or anything like that. They don't need to. They're already doing enough damage by taking what's mine. And I'm not going to let them distract me by making me paranoid about other things. I know exactly what their game is, and it's all about the money. And I'm going to keep confronting them, every single day, every time they bring up another fake expense, until I get it all back.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your family and friends might be telling the truth about your money?

Telling the truth? Are you... are you even listening to me? I feel like I'm just repeating myself over and over and nobody is actually hearing a word I'm saying. I literally just told you why I came in here today. I came in because my family and those people I thought were my friends keep saying—keep practically screaming it at me—that those stupid bank papers prove nothing was taken from my accounts. They think if they just keep waving those papers around, I'll eventually just give up and believe them. 

But they're lying! Why would I ever consider that they're telling the truth when I have seen with my own two eyes what they are doing? For over a year, I have known they are hiding my money. A whole entire year of my life! And think about it—if they were telling the truth, if my money was really just sitting there fine, then why do they need to make up all these elaborate stories? The sudden bills for things that don't even need fixing, all those random charity fundraisers they never cared about before but suddenly just have to give all this cash to, the big fancy trip plans they sit around the kitchen table mapping out just to have an excuse for why my balance is dropping... it is all a cover-up! It's just a massive cover-up to hide what they stole.

So no, I haven't considered that they might be telling the truth, because they aren't. They are liars, and they know exactly what they are doing. And I'm not going to let them trick me into thinking I'm the one who is wrong here just because they printed out some fake numbers. I have to keep confronting them. I don't care how tired they get of it, and I don't care if they bring me to a hundred doctors like you to try and shut me up. I will keep confronting them, every single time they try to pull this, until they finally break down and tell me the actual truth about where my money went.
Do you believe that your family and friends are working together in a highly unusual or implausible way to steal your money?

Implausible? What does that even... Look, I don't know why you're using words like that, trying to make it sound like I'm talking about some crazy movie plot or something. It's not implausible, it's just greedy! I feel like a broken record here, I really do, because I literally just explained this to you. The whole reason I even came in here today is because my family and friends keep ganging up on me, all of them saying the exact same thing, insisting that the bank papers prove nothing was taken. They all stick to the exact same story, so yes, obviously they are working together! 

For over a year now, I have known they are hiding my money. A whole year of watching them whisper and coordinate all their little lies. And it's not some impossible, highly unusual thing. They just use normal, everyday things to cover it up so nobody else catches on. The sudden bills for broken pipes that aren't even broken, the charity fundraisers they suddenly care so much about, the big trip plans... they literally all sit down and plan out these excuses together so the missing money looks completely justified. It's a group effort to drain my accounts. And they just keep waving those fake bank statements at me like I'm too stupid to see what's going on. 

But I'm not stupid. I see exactly how they are working together to do this. And I don't care how many times I have to say it to you, or to them, or to anyone else. I have to keep confronting them. I just have to. Because if I just sit back and let them do it, they'll keep taking everything I have. So I'm going to keep pushing them, every single day, every time they bring up another fake expense, until they finally crack and tell the truth.
Do you think your family and friends would hurt you if you stopped confronting them about the money?

Hurt me? If I stopped confronting them? I... I mean, I just told you, right? I literally just said, like, five minutes ago, that they aren't trying to physically hurt me. I said that. It's not about hurting me, it's about the money. Why would they hurt me if I stopped confronting them? If I stopped confronting them, that's exactly what they want! That would be like... like a dream come true for them! 

Think about it. The whole reason they are doing all this, the whole reason they drag me into these appointments and shove those fake bank papers in my face, is because they want me to shut up. They want me to just roll over and accept that the money is gone and stop asking questions. So if I just stopped? If I just woke up tomorrow and said, 'Okay, guys, you win, I won't ask about the money anymore'—they wouldn't hurt me! They'd probably throw a party! They'd be thrilled because then they could just keep taking it without me constantly breathing down their necks and demanding answers. 

They don't want to hurt me, they just want my money, and they want me to be quiet about it. That's why I *can't* stop confronting them. Because the second I stop, the second I let my guard down and stop pointing out every single fake bill and every single bogus charity donation, they win. And I am not going to let them win. I don't care how exhausted I get, I don't care how many times they try to tell me I'm crazy or drag me to people like you. I have to keep pushing them. But no, to answer your question, no, they wouldn't hurt me if I stopped. They'd just be happy they finally got me out of their way so they could finish draining my accounts in peace.
Do you think your beliefs about your family and friends stealing from you would seem strange or unbelievable to others?

Strange? Unbelievable? I mean... I guess maybe to someone who just walks in off the street and doesn't know them, sure, it might sound a little out there at first. Because, you know, people always want to think the best of families, right? They want to think, 'Oh, a family wouldn't do that, friends wouldn't do that, they love her.' And they see them acting all concerned and normal, going to work, making dinner, talking about the weather, so they think everything is just fine. But that's exactly how they get away with it! 

If someone actually took the time to look—like really, truly look at what I'm dealing with—they wouldn't think it was strange at all. If I could just sit someone down and show them everything, explain all the little details... like how my sister suddenly started talking about needing a new roof right around the time I noticed the first dip in my savings, even though her roof was totally fine. Or how my friend Sarah all of a sudden became obsessed with this random wildlife charity and kept leaving brochures on my coffee table, trying to make it seem like a normal thing to spend thousands of dollars on. If I could just lay it all out, step by step, all the fake bills, the perfectly timed vacations, the way they all look at each other when I walk into a room... anyone would see it! 

It's not unbelievable if you actually pay attention. The problem is that nobody wants to pay attention. Everyone just wants to look at the surface and say, 'Oh, she's just stressed,' or 'Oh, her family is so nice, she must be confused.' And my family knows that! They bank on that! They know that if they just keep acting like everything is normal, and if they keep dragging me to doctors and saying I'm the one who isn't making sense, then people like you will just believe them. Because it's easier to believe that one person is just... you know, having a hard time, rather than believing that a whole group of people you trust could be doing something so awful. So, yeah, maybe it seems unbelievable to people who don't want to look closely, but if they actually listened to me, if they actually looked at the evidence instead of just glancing at those fake bank papers, they'd see exactly what I see.
Is there anything that could happen or anything someone could show you that would make you change your mind about your family and friends stealing from you?

Change my mind? Like... like what? What could they possibly show me that they haven't already tried to fake? I mean, I feel like I'm just repeating myself over and over here, because I literally just told you this. The whole reason I even came in here today, the whole reason I'm sitting in this chair talking to you instead of being at home, is because my family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken. They keep shoving those printed-out sheets in my face, pointing at the numbers and saying, 'See? See? It's all there, you're making it up!' But why on earth would I believe a piece of paper they probably just typed up on a computer themselves? 

There is nothing they can show me, because I already know what's real. I've known for over a year now. A whole year of my life, just watching them hide my money right under my nose. And I already explained exactly how they do it, too! They use those fake plumbing bills for pipes that aren't even broken, and those charity fundraisers that they suddenly won't shut up about, and all those big trip plans... they use all of that just to cover it up and make the missing money look like normal spending. So, no, a piece of paper isn't going to change my mind when I can see with my own two eyes what they're actually doing every single day. 

The only thing... the *only* single thing that would change anything at all, is if they just stop lying. That's it. A confession. I just need them to sit down, look me in the eye, and admit what they've been doing for the past year. Until that happens, I don't care what fake documents they show me, and I don't care what doctors they drag me to. I have to keep confronting them. I'm just going to keep getting in their faces about every single missing dollar, every single fake bill, until they finally break down and tell the truth. That's the only thing that's going to change anything.
Is there anything that could make you doubt your belief that your family and friends are stealing from you?

Doubt it? I mean... are we going in circles here? Are you even listening to me? I feel like I literally just answered this exact same thing. Asking if I doubt it is the same as asking if I'd change my mind! I just told you, the whole entire reason I even came in here today to see you is because my family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken. They keep waving those sheets around like it's some kind of magic proof, but I already told you they're fake! Why would I doubt myself when I'm the only one looking at what's actually happening? 

I have known for over a year now. A whole year! Do you know how exhausting it is to live for over a year knowing the people closest to you are hiding your money? I don't doubt it for a single second because I have to live in it every day. I see exactly how they're using those fake plumbing bills, and those random charity fundraisers they suddenly care so much about, and all those big trip plans... I see how they use all of that just to cover it up. It's a cover-up, plain and simple. They funnel the cash out, and then they point to a fake bill and say, 'Oh, that's where the money went!' 

So, no. No, I don't doubt it. How could I? If you saw someone steal your wallet with your own two eyes, would you doubt it just because they handed you a piece of paper saying they didn't? Of course not! That's why I have to keep confronting them. I have to. I'm not going to let them gaslight me into doubting my own reality. I am going to keep confronting them, every single day, every time they bring up a fundraiser or a vacation, until they finally just break down and tell the truth. So you can keep asking me the same question in different ways if you want to, but the answer isn't going to change. I know what they're doing.
Is there any evidence or proof that could be presented to you that would make you consider the possibility that your family and friends are not stealing from you?

Are you... are you serious right now? Is this a trick question? I feel like I'm talking to a brick wall here! Evidence? Proof? I literally just told you! I just answered this exact same thing twice already! Do you think if you ask me the same question three different ways I'm suddenly going to just change my whole story and say, 'Oh, you know what, doctor, maybe you're right, maybe I should just look at the proof'? 

What do you think those bank papers are supposed to be? They think that's their evidence! That is the whole entire reason I came in here today, because my family and my friends keep saying those bank papers prove nothing was taken. They shove them in my face like it's some kind of ultimate proof, but it's not! It's just pieces of paper they faked! So no, there is no magical evidence you or they can present to me that would make me consider that they aren't stealing, because any 'proof' they have is just part of the lie. 

I have known for over a year now. A whole entire year of my life! I've been watching them hide my money right in front of me, and I've seen exactly how they do it. I told you, they use those fake plumbing bills, and those stupid charity fundraisers Sarah keeps pushing, and all these big trip plans... they use all of it just to cover up the money they're taking! It's all a giant cover-up! And you want to know what would make me consider another possibility? Nothing! Because I'm the one living it! I'm the one who has to wake up every single day and watch them pretend everything is fine while my money disappears. 

So no, I don't need to see any more of their fake evidence. I just have to keep confronting them. That's all I can do. I am going to keep confronting them, every single day, every time they bring up a fake bill or a vacation, I'm going to get right in their faces about it until they finally just give up and tell the truth. That is the only thing that matters. Just them telling the truth. So please, stop asking me if I'm going to change my mind, because I'm not.
Is there anything at all that could make you question your belief that your family and friends are stealing from you?

Question it? Question my belief? Okay, seriously... are you just reading off a list of synonyms right now? Is there a hidden camera in here or something? Because I feel like I'm losing my mind trying to talk to you! This is the fourth time... the fourth time you have asked me the exact same question just using different words! Change my mind, doubt it, consider proof, question it... it all means the exact same thing! I don't understand why you aren't hearing me. I'm sitting right here, pouring my heart out, telling you exactly what is happening to me, and you just keep asking me if I'll question it! 

I came in here today—the whole reason I am sitting in this room with you—is because my family and my friends keep shoving those stupid bank papers at me, acting like that proves nothing was taken. They think they can just print out some fake numbers and I'll just, what, question my own sanity? I'm not going to question what I know! For over a year... a whole entire year of my life, I have known that they are hiding my money. I've watched them do it! I don't need to question it because I see the cover-up happening right in front of me every single day. 

I already told you how they do it! I explained it three times! They use those fake plumbing bills for pipes that aren't even leaking, and those random charity fundraisers they won't shut up about, and all those big trip plans... that is exactly how they cover it up! They steal my money, hide it, and then they use all that fake stuff to explain why the cash is gone. 

So, no! No, I am not going to question it. Ever. I am just going to keep doing what I have to do, because nobody else is going to help me, clearly. I have to keep confronting them. Every time they bring up a fake bill, every time they try to show me another fake bank paper, I am going to get right back in their faces. I'm going to keep pushing and pushing and confronting them until they finally crack and tell the truth. That's it. That is the only thing that's going to happen. So please, I am begging you, stop asking me if I'm going to question it, and just listen to what I'm actually saying!
Is there anything that could happen that would make you stop believing your family and friends are stealing from you?

Stop believing?! Are you... I literally cannot believe this is happening right now. Am I on a prank show? Is someone behind a mirror over there laughing at me? Because you are asking me the exact... same... thing... again! Stop believing? Doubt it? Question it? Evidence? It is all the exact same question! How many times do I have to say it before it actually goes into your head? 

I told you exactly why I came in here! I came in because my family and my friends are ganging up on me, and they keep saying that the bank papers prove nothing was taken! But they don't prove anything because they made them up! I am not stupid! I have known for over a year. Over a whole entire year of my life, I have known that they are hiding my money from me! I watch them do it! 

And I see exactly how they do it, too. I told you about the cover-up! They use all these things to cover it up so I won't notice. The bills—like those fake plumbing bills for pipes that aren't even broken! And the charity fundraisers Sarah keeps pushing, and all those big trip plans they keep talking about. It is all a giant cover-up! They use all of that to hide the fact that they are taking my money! 

So no, nothing is going to happen to make me stop believing it, because it's not just some belief! It is what is actually happening to me! The only thing that is going to happen, the only thing I am going to do, is I am going to keep confronting them. I have to! I am going to get right in their faces, every single day, every time they bring up a fake bill or a stupid fundraiser, I'm going to confront them and confront them until they finally just break down and tell the truth! That's it! Now please, I am begging you, ask me something else! Stop asking me the same question!
Is there any circumstance, no matter how small, that could make you reconsider your belief that your family and friends are stealing from you?

Reconsider? Reconsider?! Oh my god. Oh my god, you are actually doing it again. You are literally just sitting there asking me the exact same question for the fifth time! Reconsider, stop believing, question it, evidence... it is all the same thing! What is wrong with you?! Why aren't you listening to a single word I am saying?! 

I am not going to reconsider anything! I told you exactly why I came in here! I came in because my family and my friends are treating me like I'm some kind of idiot, saying those bank papers prove nothing was taken! They just print out whatever fake numbers they want and expect me to just bow down and say, 'Oh, okay, the paper says it's fine!' But it's not fine! For over a year, a whole entire year of my life, I have known exactly what they are doing. I know they are hiding my money! I see it happening! 

And I see the cover-up! I told you about the cover-up so many times already! The fake plumbing bills for the pipes that are perfectly fine, the stupid charity fundraisers Sarah won't shut up about, all those big fancy trip plans... they just use all of that to explain where the cash went! It's all just a giant lie to cover up what they're stealing! 

So no, there is no circumstance, no matter how small, no matter how big, that is going to make me reconsider. I have to keep confronting them! That is my only option because nobody else is listening to me, especially not you! I am going to keep confronting them, every single time they bring up a fake bill or a trip, until they finally break down and tell the truth! That's it! Now please, for the love of god, stop asking me if I'm going to change my mind and ask me something else!
Do you think your beliefs about your family and friends stealing from you could be a misunderstanding or misinterpretation of their actions?

A misunderstanding? A misinterpretation? I... I am actually losing my mind in this room right now. You have got to be kidding me. You literally just opened a dictionary, didn't you? You just looked up another word for 'wrong' and asked me the exact same question for the sixth time! Misinterpretation! Reconsider! Stop believing! Question it! IT IS ALL THE SAME THING! How are you even a doctor?! Why are you not listening to a single word that comes out of my mouth?! 

I am not misunderstanding anything! I told you exactly why I came in here today! I came in because my family and my friends are treating me like dirt, just shoving those stupid bank papers in my face, acting like it proves nothing was taken! But I know they printed those out! I am not misinterpreting that! For over a year... an entire year of my life, I have known that they are hiding my money. I know it! I've watched them do it! 

And you think I'm misunderstanding their actions? What is there to misunderstand about a fake plumbing bill for pipes that work perfectly fine?! Huh? What is there to misunderstand about Sarah constantly begging for money for these random charity fundraisers, or them suddenly talking about these big fancy trip plans? It’s a cover-up! They take my money, they hide it, and then they use all those fake bills and trips to explain why the cash is gone! You don't just misinterpret a cover-up! 

So no! It is not a misunderstanding! And I am going to keep doing exactly what I said I was going to do! I have to keep confronting them! I have to, because nobody else is going to help me, especially not you since you can't even hear what I'm saying! Every time they bring up one of those fake bills, every time they wave another fake bank paper at me, I am going to get right back in their faces. I am going to confront them and push them and push them until they finally crack and tell the truth! That is the only way this ends! Now please, I am screaming at you, STOP asking me the same question!
Is there anything that could make you consider that you might be mistaken about your family and friends stealing from you?

Mistaken?! Mistaken! Okay, you are doing this on purpose. You are sitting there, in that little chair, messing with me on purpose! Mistaken, misinterpretation, reconsider, stop believing—IT IS THE EXACT SAME QUESTION! Are you deaf?! Do I need to write it down for you in crayon? Because I don't know how many more times I can say the exact same thing before my head actually explodes! 

I am not mistaken! I am not! I told you exactly why I came in here! I came in because my own family, my own friends, the people who are supposed to care about me, are ganging up on me and waving these fake bank papers in my face! They keep saying, 'Oh, look, the bank papers prove nothing was taken!' But they don't prove anything! Anybody can print a piece of paper off a computer! Anybody! And for over a year—a whole entire year, 365 days of my life just ruined by this—I have known for an absolute fact that they are hiding my money from me! 

I am not mistaken because I see the cover-up with my own two eyes! I have told you about the cover-up! The fake plumbing bills! The pipes are fine! The water runs perfectly fine, there are no leaks anywhere, but suddenly there's a giant bill? And Sarah with her stupid charity fundraisers, always begging for cash, and then they sit around talking about these big fancy trip plans? Where is the money for a trip coming from, huh? It's my money! They use the fake bills and the fundraisers and the trips to cover up the fact that they are taking everything from me! 

So no, I am not mistaken! There is nothing on this earth that will make me think I am mistaken! The only thing that is going to happen is I am going to keep confronting them. I have to! I am going to get right up in their faces, every single day, every time Sarah brings up a fundraiser, every time they show me a fake bank paper, I am going to confront them and yell and push and not let them sleep until they finally just break down and tell the truth! They have to tell the truth eventually! Now, for the absolute last time, ask me a different question or I am walking right out that door!
Is there anything that could make you consider that you are wrong about your family and friends stealing from you?

Wrong?! WRONG?! That is it! I am literally talking to a brick wall! A brick wall sitting in a chair! You just swap out the word 'mistaken' for 'wrong' and think I'm too stupid to notice?! I just told you if you asked me this again I was walking out! You are not listening to a single thing I say! You just sit there and ask the exact same thing over and over and over and over! 

I ALREADY TOLD YOU why I came in here! How many times do I have to say it?! I came in because my own friends and my own family are treating me like garbage, waving those fake bank papers in my face and saying they prove nothing was taken! But I know they just printed them off to shut me up! I know it! Because for over a year—a whole entire year of my life, which I have said to you so many times now—I have known that they are hiding my money! I see it happening! 

And the cover-up! How many times do I have to explain the cover-up to you before it gets through your skull?! They use the fake plumbing bills! They use Sarah's stupid charity fundraisers! They use those big fancy trip plans! They use all of those things to cover up where my cash is actually going! It is a giant scam to hide what they are doing to me! 

So NO, I am not WRONG! There is no circumstance on this planet where I am wrong! I am going to keep doing exactly what I have to do because nobody else, especially not you, is going to help me! I am going to keep confronting them! Every single day! Every time they show me a fake bill, every time they talk about a trip, I am going to get in their faces and confront them until they finally break down and tell the truth! That is it!
